# DriveTest Pro

> DriveTest Pro helps Ontario learners prepare for the G1 knowledge test with MTO-based study materials, road-sign and rules practice, realistic simulations, and AI explanations.

## Primary public pages

- Home: https://www.driverguide.ca/
- Ontario G1 study guide: https://www.driverguide.ca/study-guide
- Ontario G1 practice test: https://www.driverguide.ca/g1-practice-test
- Ontario road-sign practice: https://www.driverguide.ca/ontario-road-signs-practice-test
- Ontario rules-of-the-road practice: https://www.driverguide.ca/g1-rules-of-the-road-practice
- Ontario G1 test simulation: https://www.driverguide.ca/g1-test-simulation
- G1 learning guides: https://www.driverguide.ca/guides
- Ontario G1 AI driving tutor: https://www.driverguide.ca/ask-ai
- G1 test frequently asked questions: https://www.driverguide.ca/faq
- Pricing: https://www.driverguide.ca/pricing
- Sources and review process: https://www.driverguide.ca/sources
- Editorial policy: https://www.driverguide.ca/editorial-policy
- About DriveTest Pro: https://www.driverguide.ca/about
- Sitemap: https://www.driverguide.ca/sitemap.xml

## Important context

- The site focuses on Ontario's G1 knowledge test.
- Study content is based on Ministry of Transportation of Ontario materials.
- DriveTest Pro is not affiliated with or endorsed by the MTO or DriveTest Canada.
- Account, payment, quiz-session, result, and dashboard pages are private utility areas and should not be indexed or summarized.
